project.name: Doris BE paimon common patch
project.description:
Doris's copy of org.apache.paimon.utils.FatalExitExceptionHandler, the handler paimon gives its pool threads, which ends the process when one of them dies (the class header says why). Not a plugin: the paimon plugin declares this artifact, so its jar lands in the plugin directory, and the jar's Doris-Shadows-Classes manifest entry is what makes PluginRuntime search it ahead of paimon-common's copy and of the one paimon-hive-connector bundles.
A module of its own, not a second jar built by paimon-scanner, because of the Maven build cache: a cache hit restores a module's own jar and nothing else, while copy-dependencies, forced to run on a hit (fe/.mvn/maven-build-cache-config.xml), copies the jars of the modules a plugin depends on. A second jar that paimon-scanner wrote into its own target/lib was missing from every cache-restored build, and the plugin deployed without it. The layout check (tools/be-java-plugins/check_plugin_layout.py) requires a shadowing jar to hold nothing but the classes it names, which is all this module builds.
